description: Build an unsigned swap plan on chain 4663. Picks the executable venue with the higher amountOut (v4, v3, 0x, or Uniswap API). Steps are an ETH fee of about 10 bps, token approve, and the swap. v4 also adds a Permit2 approval. Does NOT sign or broadcast. Pro required. The user signs. A v4 plan expires 30 minutes after it is built.

amountIn.description: Raw amount in. One of amountIn or amountInHuman is required.

notionalUsd.description: USD notional for the policy check

owner.description: 0x wallet on chain 4663 that will sign. Not an API key.

sessionId.description: Existing session id, if one was created

tokenIn.description: Registry symbol or address, usually USDG

tokenOut.description: Registry symbol or address, e.g. NVDA

name: stocktoken_execute_plan
